acceptedDesign.architecture: quota-preflighted synchronous browser-private staging followed by one backpressured 512 KiB final copy to the selected destination
acceptedDesign.wrapperSpecialization: skip decoder-oriented stream analysis, synthesize monotonic H.264/HEVC decode timestamps from bounded Matroska timing metadata, and supply the AAC frame size required by MP4 without decoding packets
acceptedDesign.scratchPolicy: the complete output exists temporarily only in repository-tested origin-private storage, is copied with one reusable 512 KiB buffer, and is deleted on success, failure, cancellation, or worker replacement
acceptedDesign.acceptance: three repeatable runs at 207.094 MiB worst complete-Chromium incremental private memory, plus a strict exact-packet run at 238.023 MiB

storagePolicy: All raw reports, browser profiles, converted outputs, and build artifacts are repository-local and are deleted after compact evidence is retained.
